approved_scope.title: Print a single-choice interview answer literally in the approval refusal, so the named change answer command runs as printed (#958)
approved_scope.description: Print a single-choice interview answer literally in the approval refusal, so the named change answer command runs as printed (#958)
acceptance_criteria: A question with two or more choices keeps the `<a|b>` placeholder (`<yes|no>`), and one with no choices keeps `"<answer>"`.
The approval guard refuses exactly the definitions it refused before; only the refusal text for a single-choice question changes.
The changed unit test and the documented-workflow probe fail on main db641967 before the change and pass after it.
The documented-workflow probe runs the single-choice command exactly as printed: the harness no longer rewrites `<none>`.

The unfinished-interview refusal for a question with exactly one choice names that choice literally, e.g. `specsync change answer <id> constraints none`, so the command runs as printed (REQ-change-133, DOCS-3.a, proposed DOCS-3.b).

answers.constraints: specs/cmd_change/cmd_change.3md z=8 ("Every surface that names a next step asks the same question", #902): the refusal and both status forms must name one command, so one helper builds it and the probe checks all three. specs/change/change.3md z=19 (#917): a recovery must be runnable in the record state, so change answer stays draft-only; the single-choice placeholder decision there is the one Leif reversed for #958 (DOCS-3.b). z=15 (#883): refusal text changes, the guard refuses exactly what it refused before.
